verdict.rationale: A managed AI gateway with a dashboard could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The coding-agents setup only routes external coding agents through the gateway, and the ToolLoopAgent snippet is an SDK primitive for developers to build their own agents; both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
